newsitem.title: POLAND: MERRILL PLACES GDANSK REFINERY LOAN.
newsitem.headline: MERRILL PLACES GDANSK REFINERY LOAN.

text.p: The U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch has sucessfully completed the syndication of a $100 million five-year loan for Poland's second largest Gdansk refinery, the refinery said in a statement on Monday.
It said Merrill Lynch placed the unsecured loan among financial institutions from Europe, North America and Asia.
"During the syndication there was a high oversubscription of offers...which signals that financial markets estimate the reifnery's credit and development potential as high," the statement said.
The $100 million loan will cover the refinery's investment needs in 1997 and is the first tranche of a $420 million, three-year modernisation programme, the company said.
